newsitem.title: USA: Valero sees better contribution from Basis.
newsitem.headline: Valero sees better contribution from Basis.

text.p: Valero Energy Corp expects its acquisition of the 300,000 barrel per day refining assets of Basis Corp to contribute $20 million in operating income in the second quarter of 1997, up from an original estimate of about $6 million per month.
"Volumes and performance are what we had forecast and margins have been very good. We will get two months of contribution from Basis in the second quarter," said a spokesman for Valero.
Analysts estimate this could add $0.10 per share to Valero's second quarter earnings.
The Valero spokesman said that whether the improved second quarter performance translated into a better performance for the full year depended on refining margins.
